strain: Cntnap2 -/- (KO), Cntnap2 +/- (Het) and Cntnap2 +/+ (WT) isogenic littermates on C57BL/6J background (JAX017482)

age.evidence: 8-10 weeks old mice of both genders were used for behavioural experiments.

sex.evidence: 8-10 weeks old mice of both genders were used for behavioural experiments.

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (Usona Institute US) was dissolved in sterile saline solution (0.9% NaCl)... 8-week old offspring were intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg) 24 hours prior to behavioural testing.

RG108 was dissolved in 10% DMSO then diluted using saline... Two doses of 10 mg/kg RG108 or vehicle was systemically administered via intraperitoneal injections per test animal, first dose at 60 min prior to psilocybin or saline treatment, second dose together with psilocybin or saline treatment.

MDL100907 was dissolved in 10% DMSO then diluted using saline. One dose of 1 mg/kg MDL100907 or vehicle was systemically administered via intraperitoneal injections per test animal at 15 min prior to psilocybin or saline treatment.

group_housing.evidence: housed in groups of up to five animals per cage after weaning... Mice were group-housed where possible, with the same littermate mice both before and after treatments.

day_night_flipped.evidence: on a 12/12 h light/dark cycle (light on between 07:00-19:00)... All experiments were conducted during the light phase.

assays.assay_description: Custom Plexiglass three-chamber box (60 x 40 x 22 cm; three 20 x 40 cm chambers joined by 4 x 4 cm doors, acrylic floor). Stranger mouse in a slotted transparent cylinder vs empty cylinder. 10-min test at 1 day, 1 week and 2 weeks after a single i.p. psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or saline injection. A separate cohort was tested only at 2 weeks. Pretreatment variants used RG108 (DNMTi) or MDL100907 (5HT2AR antagonist). Sniffing/crawling on cups was manually timed to derive a sociability index and total cup exploration.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg) 24 hours prior to behavioural testing; RG108 and MDL100907 also given via intraperitoneal injections

setup_habituation.evidence: Each test mouse was placed into the centre chamber and allowed to freely explore and habituate to the three-chamber setup for 10 minutes over 3 consecutive days

setup_restrain.evidence: The test mouse was then allowed to freely explore chambers for 10 minutes.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the three-chamber apparatus during testing (standard apparatus); food ad libitum in home cage

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the three-chamber apparatus during testing (standard apparatus); water ad libitum in home cage

time_to_assay.evidence: We assessed the social behaviour of these mice using the three-chamber social behaviour test at 1 day, 1 week, and 2 weeks after the single injection

sample_size.evidence: not reported in the provided text (individual data points shown in figures; n not stated)

outcomes.summary: A single 1 mg/kg psilocybin injection restored the reduced sociability of Cntnap2-/- KO mice to wild-type levels. The rescue persisted for at least 2 weeks and was largest at 1 week; it was also seen in mice tested for the first time at 2 weeks. In WT mice psilocybin reduced sociability at 1 day. The KO rescue was blocked by RG108 (DNMTi) or MDL100907 (5HT2AR antagonist) pretreatment, and no sex effect was detected.
outcomes.statistics: KO Veh vs WT Veh p = 0.042; KO Psi vs KO Veh p < 0.001; KO Psi vs WT Veh p = 0.796 (Bonferroni); sex p = 0.850; first-test-at-2-weeks cohort p = 0.025; per timepoint 1 day p = 0.007, 1 week p < 0.001, 2 weeks p = 0.028; WT Veh vs WT Psi 1 day p = 0.001, 1 week p = 0.155, 2 weeks p = 0.207; KO Veh::Psi vs KO DNMTi::Psi p = 0.003; KO Veh::Psi vs KO 5HT2AR-ant::Psi p = 0.001; DNMTi::Psi vs 5HT2AR-ant::Psi p = 1.000
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin-treated homozygous mutant KO group showed a significant increase in sociability compared to the vehicle-treated Cntnap2 -/- Vehicle KO control group (p < 0.001...) and this effect was sustained for at least two weeks following the single psilocybin administration.

B1_num_measures.evidence: sociability index derived from interaction time with S vs C cup; total time a mouse spent exploring any cup (Extended Data Fig 1a)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only session totals reported; comparisons across days are between-session

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported

B4_ethological.evidence: we manually quantified the actual interaction duration of the test mouse with the cup quantified as either sniffing or crawling on a cup

B5_social.evidence: unfamiliar non-littermate mouse (S) was placed into a cup in one side chamber; Transparent cylinders... with 1-cm slits were used as cups

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate social preference test; no learning component

B7_automated_classification.evidence: manually time the duration of the test mouse's social exploratory behaviour by a blinded well-trained observer

E3_bedding.evidence: three-chamber box with matt white acrylic floor

E6_spatial.evidence: divided in three smaller evenly sized chambers (20 x 40 x 22 cm) interconnected by 4 x 4 cm doors

E7_social_context.evidence: unfamiliar non-littermate mouse (S) was placed into a cup in one side chamber

D1_continuity.evidence: Re-testing sessions at day 7 and day 14 after administration were performed using the day 4 protocol

D2_session_duration.evidence: The test mouse was then allowed to freely explore chambers for 10 minutes.

D3_recording_days.evidence: at 1 day, 1 week, and 2 weeks after the single injection (3 recording days)

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug sociability test reported; habituation sessions had no stranger mouse

D5_followup.evidence: tested 24 h, 1 week and 2 weeks after the single injection

assays.assay_name: Habituation-phase locomotion and self-grooming (three-chamber, no social partner)
assays.assay_description: 10-min free exploration of the empty three-chamber apparatus without a social partner. Recorded during the final pre-drug habituation session and on test days 1 day and 1 week after treatment. DeepLabCut position tracking gave distance travelled and chamber occupancy; self-grooming episodes were manually scored by a blinded observer.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg) 24 hours prior to behavioural testing

setup_habituation.evidence: allowed to freely explore and habituate to the three-chamber setup for 10 minutes over 3 consecutive days

setup_restrain.evidence: each test animal was allowed to freely explore all three empty chambers for 10 minutes

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the apparatus during testing

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the apparatus during testing

time_to_assay.evidence: at 1 day after drug treatment... or at 1 week after drug treatment; plus final habituation session prior to drug treatments

outcomes.summary: Before treatment, Cntnap2-/- KO mice showed more self-grooming episodes and greater distance travelled than WT mice. Psilocybin did not alter grooming or locomotion in KO mice at 1 day or 1 week post-treatment. DNMTi pretreatment did not affect either measure in WT mice.
outcomes.statistics: Grooming WT vs KO p = 0.002 (Mann Whitney); KO Veh vs KO Psi 1 day p = 0.329, 1 week p = 0.461; distance WT vs KO p = 0.001 (Dunn's); KO Veh vs KO Psi 1 day p = 0.518, 1 week p = 0.976; WT Veh::Veh vs DNMTi::Veh grooming p = 0.222, distance p = 0.128
outcomes.evidence: We therefore concluded that repetitive behaviour, although increased in Cntnap2 -/-KO mice, is not affected by psilocybin... We therefore concluded that psilocybin has no lasting effect on spontaneous locomotory drive.

B1_num_measures.evidence: number of self-grooming episodes; distance travelled; chamber occupancy during the habituation phase

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Grooming counted as episodes only; no syntax/bout analysis

B4_ethological.evidence: We examined repetitive behaviour by quantifying self-grooming activity during habituation

B5_social.evidence: tracked the positions of the test mice during the habituation phase without the introduction of a social partner

B7_automated_classification.evidence: We used DeepLabCut to track the positions... labelled by a trained network to identify at least 4 body parts including the snout, two ears, tail base

E6_spatial.evidence: divided in three smaller evenly sized chambers interconnected by 4 x 4 cm doors

E7_social_context.evidence: without the introduction of a social partner

D1_continuity.evidence: final habituation session prior to drug treatments; at 1 day after drug treatment; at 1 week after drug treatment

D2_session_duration.evidence: distance travelled during the 10 minutes observation period

D3_recording_days.evidence: pre-treatment habituation session, 1 day and 1 week post-treatment

D4_baseline.evidence: Cntnap2 -/- ... displayed significantly higher number of self-grooming episodes compared to Cntnap2 +/+ ... during the final habituation session prior to drug treatments (Fig 1c)

D5_followup.evidence: at 1 day after drug treatment... or at 1 week after drug treatment

assays.assay_description: Head twitches counted by direct observation in 5-min bins for 20 min immediately after i.p. psilocybin or saline. Done in a 40 x 20 x 20 cm box with clean bedding, including RG108 and MDL100907 pretreatment groups.

application_type.evidence: Head-twitch events were evaluated immediately after intraperitoneal administration of either saline or psilocybin

setup_restrain.evidence: The mouse was placed into a customized behavioural box immediately after injection and was free to explore.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the HTR box

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the HTR box

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after psilocybin application, we assayed the HTR for a 20 minutes observation period

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin significantly increased HTR to a similar level in WT, heterozygous and KO mice, with no genotype or sex differences. HTR did not correlate with sociability in KO mice. MDL100907 abolished psilocybin-induced HTR, whereas RG108 did not affect it.
outcomes.statistics: WT Veh vs WT Psi p < 0.001; KO Veh vs KO Psi p = 0.001; Het Veh vs Het Psi p = 0.006 (Dunn's); between-genotype Psi comparisons p > 0.9999; sex p = 0.452 (Mann Whitney); KO Veh::Psi vs KO 5HT2AR-ant::Psi p < 0.001; KO Veh::Psi vs KO DNMTi::Psi p > 0.999
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin significantly increased HTR in all genotype groups (p < 0.001... p = 0.001... p = 0.006; Dunn's post-hoc) to a similar level

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of head-twitch events were counted

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The number of head-twitch events were counted by direct observation in 5-minute bins.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR excluded as ethological per rubric

E1_environment_type.evidence: customized behavioural box... 40 cm X 20 cm X 20 cm

E3_bedding.evidence: the floor was covered with clean bedding

E6_spatial.evidence: The box is of size 40 cm X 20 cm X 20 cm

E7_social_context.evidence: each mouse was placed in a separate chamber to assess the head-twitch response

D1_continuity.evidence: evaluated immediately after intraperitoneal administration... for a period of 20 minutes

judge_notes: Kept three assays: the three-chamber social test, the habituation-phase locomotion/grooming test and HTR. The habituation phase uses the same apparatus but measures a different domain (locomotion/repetitive behaviour, no social partner), so the rubric treats it as a separate assay.

Merged gemma's separate 'Locomotor activity' and 'Self-grooming' entries into one habituation-phase assay: both come from the same 10-min empty-apparatus session. Removed qwen's grooming and distance measures from the social assay.
Habituation assay D4 set to Yes, overriding all candidates: the paper reports grooming and locomotion differences 'during the final habituation session prior to drug treatments' (Fig 1c, 1e).
Habituation assay B7 = 1: DeepLabCut pose estimation, per rubric, matching 2 of 2 candidates who scored it. Confidence medium because it was used only for position.
Social assay B1 = 2-3 (score 1): sociability index plus total cup exploration. Gemma's score of 2 contradicted its own value.
HTR B1 = 1 measure (score 0); HTR D2 = 20 min, so score 1 (gemma's 0 was wrong).
Social assay application_type = i.p.: psilocybin, RG108 and MDL100907 were all given intraperitoneally, so it is not 'multiple'.
Added RG108 and MDL100907 dosing entries because the rubric asks for every compound administered in the behavioural experiments.
Sample sizes are not stated in the available text; left null.
